description:
A team workspace for running AI coding agents in parallel with isolated Git worktrees, live diff review, GitHub integration, and mobile access.

Lody is a team agent workspace: share coding agents with your team on phone and desktop. Shared sessions, live diffs, and one control plane keep your team and agents in sync.
Run agents in parallel with isolated Git worktrees and live diff review, use subscriptions you already have with Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Kimi, and any agent that speaks ACP, manage the same control plane in the terminal with CLI commands, and ship together in one workspace with shared sessions, usage by member, and PR, CI, and merge status in-session.
Version 0.89.4
✨ New
- Improved the interactive authentication flow for custom ACP providers.
- Improved the desktop first-run experience with clearer status and recovery paths when setup encounters a problem.
🐛 Fixes and Improvements
- Fixed inconsistent agent roles, configuration, and state across multiple session turns.
- Fixed All Changes including content from outside the current local worktree.
- Fixed the desktop updater reporting success when installation failed.
- Improved session and task list loading skeletons and localized pull-request repair prompts.
- Fixed production preview connections using the wrong environment domain.
- Updated the built-in Claude Code runtime.
- Thanks to external contributors audichuang and ImSingee.
